claude.rationale: DCT's property portfolio (T4) was absorbed into the Combined Company's logistics portfolio through a direct statutory merger in which DCT's corporate/partnership entities (T3) ceased to exist and their operations (management, leasing, development) transferred wholesale into Prologis's surviving entities — product and its operating processes crossed the boundary together, so gap_45 = 0. Both firms were similarly structured operating REITs and the merger absorbed DCT's operations into Prologis's ongoing organization (Prologis incumbent executives continuing, one DCT director added), so processes and running organization moved coherently together and gap_56 = 0. Because no structural gap was coded, gap_mitigated is NA, consistent with the slice noting no transition-services agreement was needed for a direct statutory merger. T6 is coded subset because only a minority of DCT's people/board (one director) carried over while other DCT officers held severance rather than continued-role guarantees.
